name: Generated and hand-made models without a recorded source
author: Allworld, with Meshy (hosted image-to-3D and text-to-image)

groups.origin: Meshy image-to-3D, then remeshed and re-textured by Allworld (inferred, not recorded in the repository). Danfo, keke, okada, bus, saloon and SUV, each with a near and a far level and recolours.
groups.evidence: Each file's embedded texture is a 256 px (far) or 512 px (near) unwrap of scattered islands, 10 to 61 KB, the way a generated and remeshed model is baked; the street models below are not. The owner's working notes (outside the repository) log Meshy image-to-3D tasks for danfo and keke (11 Oct 2026, 11:58 to 12:04), bus and okada (14:06) and a regenerated saloon and SUV (14:56). The repository commit that added the files (cecf1f680, 11 Oct 2026) only says 'authored vehicle models'.
groups.terms: Owned by Allworld: generated through the Meshy API on a paid account (the owner confirmed on 20 Oct 2026 that the account was paid). Meshy's help centre ("Can I use Meshy assets commercially", 27 Aug 2026): on a paid plan the account owns what it generates, commercial use allowed, no attribution required, provided the inputs infringe nobody's copyright and the model is not published to the Meshy community. Inputs were Allworld's own concept images and prompts; nothing was published to the community.
groups.todo: None for the terms. A committed script that rebuilds the file would still make it provably reproducible.

groups.origin: Pickup and van, near and far, in two colours each. Hand-made or scripted; the maker is not recorded.
groups.evidence: A 4 KB palette texture and 338 to 592 triangles: not the shape of a Meshy bake. The notes' ledger shows the Meshy image-to-3D requests for pickup, SUV and van refused for lack of credits (HTTP 402, 11 Oct 2026), so a generated pickup or van is not expected.
groups.terms: unverified. Ours if scripted or hand-made by Allworld; the repository holds no script or source file that builds them.
groups.todo: Say who made them and with what, or rebuild them from a committed Blender script (scripts/assets/blender/) so they are provably ours.

groups.origin: Street buildings and props: geometry of 42 to 470 triangles and one atlas of 16 painted tiles (walls, roof, window, door, stripes; 1024 px near, 512 px far), in cream, mint and sky variants. The geometry looks scripted; the tiles look generated by an image model. Neither is recorded in the repository.
groups.evidence: Triangle counts and flat faces are too low and clean for a generated mesh. The notes' ledger shows Meshy text-to-image requests on 11 Oct 2026 for wall, roof, window, door, church, mosque, shopfront, fashion, food and electronics tiles, which match the tile subjects. No script in the repository builds these files.
